ctx.x: But I have done "Honeysuckle Rose" and "Misbehavin'"---sing some of that. Then other things that Fats wrote.
Well, let's move up into the '50s again. About in the mid-50s you took a big step in your life. You met Ida, your wife.

Yes, I had just come back -- outside of Paris, and it was close to Christmastime and in Paris they didn't have the Christmas spirit as I remembered the Christmas spirit in New York, Park Avenue all lit up with trees, all the tall buildings, beautiful scene in New York and I got homesick for New York and I dropped everything -- first of all -- I might say this first when I go for contracts to the different promoters who hire me to work, they wouldn't give me the money when I first came there, naturally, because…
